nodes.name: tickets.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models and field constraints for ticket creation, partial update, notes and the stored ticket returned by the API, including trimming rules and paged results.
nodes.languageNotes: Annotated types bundle reusable constraints; TicketUpdate defaults are not validated, so an omitted field passes while an explicit null is rejected.

nodes.name: TicketCreate
nodes.summary: Manual ticket input matching the create form and CSV columns, keeping the description exactly as typed.

nodes.name: TicketUpdate
nodes.summary: Partial ticket update that forbids unknown fields and rejects an empty change.

nodes.name: NoteCreate
nodes.summary: Input for adding an operator note.

nodes.name: Customer
nodes.summary: Customer name and email embedded in a stored ticket.

nodes.name: OrderInfo
nodes.summary: Optional order ID and product name embedded in a stored ticket.

nodes.name: Note
nodes.summary: A stored operator note with its ID and timestamp.

nodes.name: Source
nodes.summary: Where a ticket came from, manual entry or a CSV import, with batch and fingerprint.

nodes.name: LatestRun
nodes.summary: Short view of a ticket's latest provider run.

nodes.name: Ticket
nodes.summary: A stored ticket as returned by the API, including the final classification, notes and source.

nodes.name: TicketPage
nodes.summary: One page of tickets with total and paging details.

nodes.name: executions.py
nodes.summary: Runs one provider on one ticket and always records the attempt: writes a Running record first, then stores the validated outcome, redacted payloads and cost, returning failures rather than raising them.

nodes.name: failed
nodes.summary: Converts a ProviderFailure into the failure fields stored on an execution.

nodes.name: attempt
nodes.summary: Calls the adapter and validates its output, converting failures, crashes and taxonomy violations into recorded outcomes with redacted payloads.

nodes.name: cost_fields
nodes.summary: Produces the rate snapshot and estimated cost stored with a run.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Inserts a Running record, attempts the provider, then completes the record with outcome, cost and duration.

nodes.name: tickets.py
nodes.summary: Ticket workflows that turn API input into stored documents: creation, partial updates, operator notes and saving the operator's final classification with its source run and edit flag.

nodes.name: RunNotUsable
nodes.summary: Raised when a named run cannot supply a ticket's final classification.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Builds a new ticket document with a generated ID and stores it.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Applies a partial update, mapping flat API fields to nested document paths.

nodes.name: add_note
nodes.summary: Appends a timestamped operator note to a ticket.

nodes.name: run_result
nodes.summary: Returns the validated answer of a successful run belonging to this ticket, or raises RunNotUsable.

nodes.name: set_classification
nodes.summary: Stores the operator's final answer, recording the source run and whether it was edited.

nodes.name: test_execution_log.py
nodes.summary: Tests for cost calculation, rate snapshots that stay fixed over time, secret-free stored records, and the execution list and detail API filters, paging and payload handling.

nodes.name: priced
nodes.summary: Fixture providing a test client whose patched Jev adapter reports real token counts and a secret header, with no network.

nodes.name: test_old_runs_keep_their_rates_when_rates_change
nodes.summary: Verifies an earlier run keeps its stored pricing version after the rates change.

nodes.name: test_list_filters_by_provider_status_ticket_and_date
nodes.summary: Verifies the execution list filters by provider, status, ticket and date.

nodes.name: test_list_is_newest_first_paged_and_leaves_out_payloads
nodes.summary: Verifies the execution list is newest first, paged and without payloads.

nodes.name: test_live_adapters.py
nodes.summary: Tests the Jev and Ollama adapters against simulated HTTP replies with no network, covering the two-step flow, token totals, failure handling, escalation thresholds and registry selection.

nodes.name: jev
nodes.summary: Helper that builds a JevAdapter wired to a simulated HTTP handler.

nodes.name: two_step
nodes.summary: Helper handler that records each simulated Jev request and returns the canned reply.

nodes.name: test_jev_asks_category_first_then_only_that_categorys_subcategories
nodes.summary: Verifies Jev's second request offers only the chosen category's subcategories.

nodes.name: test_jev_counts_tokens_from_both_steps_and_stores_both_payloads
nodes.summary: Verifies tokens are summed and both step payloads are stored.

nodes.name: test_jev_rejects_an_unknown_category_without_a_second_call
nodes.summary: Verifies an unknown category fails without making a second paid call.

nodes.name: test_jev_failure_in_the_second_step_keeps_the_first_steps_payload
nodes.summary: Verifies a second-step failure still reports the first step's payload.

nodes.name: test_jev_sends_the_key_when_one_is_configured
nodes.summary: Verifies the bearer header carries the configured API key.

nodes.name: test_unreachable_and_slow_servers
nodes.summary: Verifies network errors and timeouts become safe failures.

nodes.name: test_ollama_requests_structured_json_and_parses_it
nodes.summary: Verifies the Ollama request shape and the parsing of its JSON answer into a valid result.

nodes.name: test_ollama_non_json_reply_is_an_invalid_response
nodes.summary: Verifies a non-JSON Ollama reply becomes an invalid_response failure.

nodes.name: test_registry_picks_local_models_and_needs_no_key
nodes.summary: Verifies the registry selects local Jev and Ollama adapters without API keys.

nodes.name: test_providers.py
nodes.summary: Tests the provider contract and run recording: input fairness, HTTP failure mapping, redaction, mock behaviour, and that every attempt is logged including failures, crashes and missing keys.

nodes.name: test_input_holds_only_ticket_content_and_taxonomy
nodes.summary: Verifies provider input excludes the final classification, operator notes, customer email and the sample flag.

nodes.name: test_redaction_removes_credentials_at_any_depth
nodes.summary: Verifies credentials are removed from nested structures without changing the input.

nodes.name: test_successful_run_is_recorded
nodes.summary: Verifies a successful run produces a complete stored execution record.

nodes.name: test_record_exists_before_the_provider_answers
nodes.summary: Verifies the Running record is written before the provider is called.

nodes.name: test_payloads_are_redacted_before_saving
nodes.summary: Verifies credentials in provider payloads never reach the stored execution.

nodes.name: test_schemas.py
nodes.summary: Validation tests for the classification, execution, ticket and bulk-job schemas, including invalid pairs, trimming rules, unsupported Jev free text and taxonomy version recording.

nodes.name: test_execution_records_taxonomy_version
nodes.summary: Verifies an execution record defaults to the current taxonomy version.

nodes.name: test_ticket_create_trims_short_fields_and_keeps_description_exactly
nodes.summary: Verifies short fields are trimmed and normalized while the description stays exactly as typed.
